The structure of Yb8Ag8Ru8 (reduced formula YbAgRu) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Ag centers with 10 neighbors, including Ag, Ru, and Yb, while Ru and Yb centers each have 14 geometric neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among the 10-vertex Ag, 14-vertex Ru, and 14-vertex Yb coordination polyhedra.
